name: Interrupted Clubmoss
desc: Interrupted Clubmoss (Spinulum annotinum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 12 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Spinulum annotinum, synonym Lycopodium annotinum, known as interrupted club-moss, or stiff clubmoss, is a species of clubmoss native to forests of the colder parts of North America, as well as Asia…
